assets.name: ocean
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original full-bleed artwork for a secular contemplative web experience called Small Shrines. Create a tactile, painterly cinematic landscape artwork, 3:2 composition. A quiet sculptural stone alcove carved into pale warm limestone overlooks an immense pale turquoise ocean. A single small handmade ceramic bowl rests in the foreground on a rough low stone plinth. Pink dawn light enters from one side and grazes the porous stone. Horizon almost dissolves into mist. Architectural simplicity, remarkable material texture, restrained warm ivory, pale blue and dusty rose palette. Strong asymmetric framing with large serene negative space. Contemporary fine art editorial composition, subtle film grain, natural luminous shadows. No people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no religious symbols, no UI, no frame or border. This must be the artwork itself, not a mockup.
